gap_review: No existing product gaps are addressed.

discoveries.summary: Purpose coverage and revision integrity can be enforced independently of HTML layouts and custom feedback content.

discovery_review: Renderer equality was imposing presentation rather than artifact purpose.

documentation.rationale: Make task-specific HTML default; document registration, open feedback, provenance, optional starters and evidence limits.

summary: Allow task-specific authored HTML without fixed presentation or payload schemas.
remaining: Human visual review of the authored examples remains outside CLI and DOM evidence.

review.acceptance: Authored HTML is the default agent workflow. Five discovery purposes and three lifecycle purposes remain required, with arbitrary content and feedback payloads. Legacy renderers cannot overwrite registered authored files.
review.verification: Five targeted CLI regressions, strict Clippy and example DOM interactions passed. Full CI and completion reports are under target/verification/authored-html. Initial fast checks passed individually but source drift invalidated that baseline report.
review.assumptions: The registry is a file-integrity and provenance boundary, not a JavaScript sandbox, semantic reviewer or visual verifier. Authorship timestamps and actor labels do not prove chronology or approval.
review.coverage: Independent different-layout, open-payload, stale-feedback, missing-purpose, unsafe-path, symlink, unregistered-edit and historical-snapshot cases. Existing fixed-mode regression coverage retained. Example DOM checks cover exports and alternative/plan controls; human browser visual review remains.
